verdict.rationale: Convertio has a first-party developer API with API keys, official wrappers and a CLI, and its API pricing covers conversion minutes and concurrent conversions, so a documented cloud conversion API exists. The evidence does not show the job workflow itself: how input is submitted, how status is polled, or how output is returned. No OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: documented upload/URL input endpoints, a job-status endpoint or visible conversion status, an output-file download mechanism, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, a documented API takes an upload or URL, runs the conversion as a job with visible status, and returns the output file
